title: Foundry Adult Hockey League game analytics file, version 1 (analytics-v1)
description: Goals tagged from a game video, for the league site. One file per game per submitter, added to the site's repository at seasons/<season>/analytics/<num>-<slug>.json, where <num> is game.num and <slug> is submittedBy.team in lowercase with each run of other characters replaced by '-' (e.g. 77-sk8balls.json), or 'league'. Find game.num, the season and the site's team spellings in the site's games.json (schema games-v1) by ttsGameId first, then blackbearId; never guess a number. The site skips the whole file if the number, the submitting team, the date, the teams or ttsGameId don't match that game, and uses only goals with verified: true. Coordinates are feet on a 200 x 85 ft rink, centre ice at (0, 0), with every shot drawn as attacking the net on the +x side (goal line at x = 89). Versioning: adding an optional field the site can ignore keeps v1; any change that would break an existing file (a renamed, removed or newly required field, or a changed meaning) is a new version with a new schema file, and the site keeps reading v1 files.

num.description: The league's game number in its season (games.json 'num'). Must equal the number in the file name.

ttsGameId.description: TimeToScore game_id. Checked against the site's own when both are known.

blackbearId.description: Black Bear TV event id (blackbearsports.tv/watch/<id>). Informational.

date.description: Game date, YYYY-MM-DD, as in games.json.

away.description: Away team, spelled as in games.json.

home.description: Home team, spelled as in games.json.

youtubeUrl.description: The video that videoTime refers to. Goal links only show when it's one of the game's videos on the site.

team.description: The submitting team (one of the game's two teams), or "league" for the league's own tagging. Must agree with the file name.

goals.description: Regular-time and overtime goals. Shootout goals come from the league sheet and are not listed.

team.description: The scoring team, spelled as in games.json.

score.description: The score after this goal, home first: "<home>-<away>". Identifies the goal; no two goals in a file may share it.

videoTime.description: Seconds into youtubeUrl when the goal is scored.

pass.description: Where the pass to the scorer came from, or null.

verified.description: true only when a person confirmed this goal. Anything else is ignored by the site.

name.description: As on the team's roster; an empty name means unknown.
